name: Stellar Nursery
desc: A deep-space vista into a star-forming molecular cloud — dark dust pillars rise rim-lit against a glowing emission nebula of gold and teal gas, brilliant newborn stars flare with diffraction spikes at every depth, and foreground dust drifts across a field of distant stars as the view slowly parallax-pans.

style.doc: JWST gold/teal vs Hubble green/gold vs blue reflection vs infrared vs monochrome etched
